title: Krishna Goyal
gallery_text: Based on the works of Rafael Gustavino in vaulting systems. This research explored how identical flat tiles could form complex curved surfaces by introducing controlled gaps between them. By varying these gaps, the same simple tile could be used to build spheres, cylinders, saddles, and other positively and negatively curved forms.
